text.tspan: Without QWP1, QWP2, and polarizer, yields standard Young interference pattern at Ds..
With QWP1 and QWP2 but without polarizer, there is no interference pattern at Ds.,
With polarizer set to angle of QWP1, Ds yields interference pattern, and with it set
at the angle of QWP2, it yields the interference antifringes.
Walborn, Cunha, Padua, and Monken, Double-slit quantum eraser
